title: A game I have wanted to make for years made possible by Opus 5.5
author: SimpleJack_Mcprofit
selftext:
When I was a kid I lost a lot of hours to Age of War: two bases, one lane, and you evolve your army through the ages until someone’s fortress falls. I always had a list in my head of things I wished it did. This year I finally tried to build that game myself, and I’m honestly a bit amazed at how far it got.

It’s called [Age Breaker](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5431200/Age_Breaker/?beta=0) **(launching Nov 2nd on Steam)**. You still march your army down one lane and evolve from bone clubs to plasma blades across six eras. But it grew into its own thing:

* You train **workers who mine gold veins** in front of your keep, so raiding the other player’s miners becomes a real strategy.
* There are **four factions** that play very differently. One blows a war horn to rally the whole army, one fights in drilled squads, and one has units that grow up on the battlefield.
* The battlefield is wide and scrolls, and you can **plant a rally flag** to send your army somewhere specific.
* And the part I’m proudest of: **online multiplayer**. There’s ranked matchmaking with placement games and Elo tiers, leaderboards (global and Steam friends), and private matches where you invite a friend through Steam. Losing a ranked match to a stranger who out-mined me was the moment it felt like a real game.

Excited to see what you guys think!
